Even though her initial approach was aggressive, she did try to correct her behavior. So, was I in the right to exclude her completely, or was I being too harsh? It seems like there's a balance here. On one hand, I was justified in not giving her the eggs initially because she didn't ask and was aggressive. On the other hand, when she tried to correct her behavior, I didn't give her another chance, which might have been unfair.
